attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Serious crime is down for seven years in a row, reaching its lowest level in a quarter-century.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Violent crime is down by 24 percent.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The murder rate is down to levels unseen since the mid-1960's.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The number of juveniles committing homicides with guns is down by nearly 60 percent.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group will not go back to finger-pointing and failed strategies that led to a steep rise in crime during the Bush-Quayle years.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The group opposes surrendering to right-wing Republicans who threatened funding for new police, attempted to gut crime prevention, and would invite the NRA into the Oval Office.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The group will not return to an old approach that was tough on the causes of crime but not tough enough on crime itself.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
